# Code of conduct

This project exists to help people get at their own medical records, and the people who write in about it are often
dealing with something hard. Treat everyone here — in issues, discussions, pull requests and reviews — with the patience
you'd want in their place.

## What's expected

- Be kind and assume good faith. Questions from people who don't write code are as welcome as patches.
- Disagree about the work, not the person. Accept a "no" on a change gracefully.
- Keep health information out of the open. Never post your own or anyone else's records, ID numbers or files from a
  real export, and never ask someone else to. Describe the shape of the data, or use made-up values.

## What isn't accepted

- Harassment, insults, or demeaning remarks about anyone's identity, health or background.
- Sexualised language or imagery.
- Publishing someone else's private information, medical or otherwise, without their explicit permission.
- Anything else that a reasonable person would see as unwelcome in a project about personal health.

## Reporting

Write to `maccabi.a5s6c@addy.io`. The maintainer reads every report, keeps it private, and answers within a week. For a
security or privacy vulnerability in the extension, use the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead.

## What happens

The maintainer decides what a report calls for, from a private word to removing comments, locking a thread or banning
someone from the repository. This applies in every project space, and when someone represents the project elsewhere.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
